text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick announcement: we've rolled out an Adoption & Fertility Leave Top-up and updated guidance on documentation/privacy. Effective 2026-09-01. Full details + claim steps: https://redwood.atlassian.org/people-ops/leave/adoption-fertility-topup-2026 

Benefits-Bot: Summary: Employees who take qualifying adoption or fertility-related leave may be eligible for a wage top-up to 100% for up to 8 weeks (varies by region). Top-up is supplemental to statutory pay and Redwood parental leave. Submit claims within 60 days of leave end. 

Zoe Kim: Thanks Maya. Does this apply to foster placements and surrogacy?

Maya (People Ops): Yes — policy covers adoption, foster-to-adopt placements, surrogacy, and fertility treatments resulting in leave (medically necessary recovery). We list qualifying events in the doc. 

Ana Patel: Confused about proof: what counts as "documentation"? I don't want to share sensitive medical details with my manager.

Maya (People Ops): Good question. We only require confirmation paperwork (adoption placement notice, agency letter, clinic invoice/letter indicating procedure date). Medical notes with sensitive info are not needed. Submit docs via the confidential portal; managers only see that leave was approved, not medical details. 

Legal-Bot: Reminder: local statutory protections may require different notice windows. Policy includes country exceptions (EU, CA, UK, AU). Where law requires, we follow statutory leave first and top-up is applied where permitted. 

Zoe Kim: For hybrid teams, who approves the top-up? Manager or HR?

Maya (People Ops): Manager approves the leave request; People Ops approves the top-up claim after reviewing documentation. Payroll performs the payment run. If manager or employee needs help, ping people-ops@redwood.com. 

Payroll Team: Payroll note: Top-up payments will be processed on the next monthly payroll after claim approval. Tax treatment varies by country; payroll will apply local withholding. Expect the first top-up payout within 4-6 weeks of approval. 

Ana Patel: Can the top-up be split? e.g., two separate leave blocks for fertility treatment within 6 months?

Maya (People Ops): We support intermittent leave for qualifying treatments. Top-up eligibility is per qualifying leave event, up to the regional maximum. Submit each leave request and claim separately. 

Zoe Kim: What about contractors or part-time employees? Any eligibility?

Maya (People Ops): Contractors are not eligible for the top-up. Part-time employees are eligible pro rata if they meet minimum service requirements (see doc). We included examples for 0.6 FTE and hourly employees. 

Benefits-Bot: Confidentiality: HR redacts sensitive fields when sharing records. Only People Ops and Payroll have access to claim documents. Managers see a confirmation and expected return date. 

Ana Patel: If I change return date, will top-up be adjusted?

Maya (People Ops): Yes — submit an update via the leave form. If you extend leave, top-up may continue up to the cap and subject to manager/People Ops review. Retroactive changes allowed within 30 days with justification. 

Zoe Kim: Is there a counseling/benefits add-on for fertility? I recall folks asking about coverage and vendor list.

Maya (People Ops): We added a fertility vendor guide and a counseling referral benefit in the doc. Some vendors are reimbursable under the mental health stipend; diagnostic or treatment costs follow benefits plan rules. Check the vendor appendix and benefits portal. 

Payroll Team: Action for managers: when approving top-ups, include the leave request ID and claim reference in the approval comments to speed payroll processing. 

Maya (People Ops): We'll run two office hours next week to walk through examples (Mon 11:00 PT and Thu 16:00 PT) and post an FAQ with sample scenarios (US, UK, CA, AU). I'll also add template language for managers to use when coordinating coverage. :calendar: 

Ana Patel: Thanks Maya, that helps. Appreciate the confidentiality notes.

Zoe Kim: Will there be retroactive support for leaves already taken this year?

Maya (People Ops): Retroactive claims accepted for qualifying events after 2026-01-01 if submitted by 2026-11-30. Submit via the claim form and include dates + documentation. We'll review case-by-case. 

Benefits-Bot: Reminder: submit claims at people-ops portal > Leave Claims > Adoption & Fertility Top-up. For urgent questions email people-ops@redwood.com with subject "URGENT TOP-UP". 

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Please read the policy and DM me if you need help with the claim flow.
